questions.prompt: In the number 472, what is the 7 worth?
questions.explanation: The 7 is in the tens place, so it is worth 7 tens, which is 70.
questions.hint: Is the 7 in the ones, tens or hundreds place?

questions.prompt: 10 tens is the same as ___ hundred.
questions.explanation: Ten tens regroup into one hundred, so 10 tens = 100.
questions.hint: 10 ones makes 1 ten. What does 10 tens make?

questions.prompt: A friend says the 9 in 295 is worth 900 because 9 is a big digit. Explain in your own words what it is really worth and why.
questions.answer: The 9 is worth 90. It is in the tens place, so it means 9 tens, not 9 hundreds.
questions.explanation: The place — not the size of the digit — decides what it is worth.
questions.hint: Which place is the 9 sitting in?
